summary: First full-stack regression of Vortex Crypto Services. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed (crypto prices, public lead POST, GET /leads auth-gated, admin JWT login, /auth/me, /insights BTC via Claude, /chat multi-turn + lead capture persistence). Frontend: landing page loads with all sections (header, hero, price ticker with BTC/ETH/USDT/SOL/USDC, insights, contact/lead form, chat widget); lead form submission produces success toast and lead is persisted; AI insights returns a real 800+ char briefing for ETH; chat widget opens, returns assistant reply, and lead capture triggers success toast + saves lead visible in admin dashboard. Admin flow: /admin login with seeded credentials works and shows lead table with all 7 leads including chat-captured entries tagged '[captured via AI chat]'.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatWidget generates sessionId at module load time (const outside component). All page reloads get a new session id, but if the module is retained across hot reloads/route changes the same session id is reused across users in the same tab lifetime - acceptable for this MVP, worth documenting.

chat.reply and insight.insight are injected via dangerouslySetInnerHTML after a naive **bold** regex replacement. Since the source is Claude output, XSS risk is low but not zero - consider using a sanitiser or a markdown component.

get_current_user does not enforce role=='admin' on GET /api/leads. Any valid JWT would work. Currently only the admin user exists so no active exposure, but role check should be added for defense in depth.
/api/leads GET returns up to 1000 with no pagination - fine for now, plan pagination once volume grows.
Startup seed updates admin password if it doesn't match current .env - good idempotent behavior. bcrypt hash format is correct ($2b$).
seed_data_creation: Test-prefixed leads created via public POST /api/leads and via chat lead capture during testing. Visible in admin dashboard.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs green in ~30s. Chat lead-capture test relies on Claude emitting the [[LEAD]] tag on turn 2; if the model changes behavior the test tolerates a soft-miss by only asserting persistence when lead_captured flag is True. Admin dashboard populates via /api/leads with Bearer token from localStorage 'vortex_token'.
